admission.claim: A job file line containing a keyword such as $ncpus is read and stored as an option string, then passed to fio_options_parse which invokes dup_and_sub_options and fio_keyword_replace.
admission.observation: A line from the job file is duplicated into opts array and reaches fio_keyword_replace with a string containing a keyword.

root.claim: In fio_keyword_replace, after finding a keyword, the pointer opt is advanced past the keyword and the memcpy length is incorrectly computed as opt - o_org - 1, which is larger than the remaining string length, causing an out-of-bounds read.
root.observation: When a keyword appears near the end of the option string, the memcpy reads beyond the allocated heap buffer because the copy length exceeds the remaining bytes.

propagation.claim: The out-of-bounds read occurs directly inside fio_keyword_replace during the memcpy operation, which is the dangerous consumption of the vulnerable state.
propagation.observation: The memcpy reads past the end of the heap buffer, causing a heap-buffer-overflow.

target.claim: AddressSanitizer detects a heap-buffer-overflow during the keyword substitution in fio_keyword_replace.
target.observation: authoritative runtime oracle: ASan reports heap-buffer-overflow on read in fio_keyword_replace.
